# `discarded-read-count`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an explicitly discarded byte count returned by a partial-read method.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

A successful partial read may initialize less than the entire destination. Using
the destination without the returned count can read stale or undefined bytes.

## When it fires

Handle the count when partial progress is expected. Use the corresponding
complete-read method when the destination must be filled.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn receive(reader: anytype) !u8 {
    var bytes: [8]u8 = undefined;
    _ = try reader.read(&bytes);
    return bytes[0];
}
```
